scientific_integrity: Proof is supplied for all positive finite base sizes. Finite exact checks only supplement the proof. No claim about the existence of a homogeneous relational partial-Steiner Fraisse limit.
scientific_limitations: The kernel is the overlap count of individually unused sites in separate labelled finite one-point diagrams, not a joint-realizability count. Closed Smith formulas require connected leave; general leaves have a rank formula and constructive Gram reduction. Prior root lattice theory is used, not claimed as new. Historical priority remains provisional; no independent audit.
title: Integral Smith forms of uncovered-site overlap kernels for one-point partial-Steiner diagrams
